entities.summary: Saw O was a king of the Martaban Kingdom, ruling from 1311 to 1323. He successfully broke the nominal overlordship of Sukhothai, transforming Martaban into a truly independent kingdom. Saw O's transformation was made possible by the diplomatic efforts of his predecessor, Fa Ngum, and the military prowess of his successor, Fa Mueang Ngoa. Saw O's reign was marked by the establishment of a strong and stable government, which laid the foundations for Martaban's future growth and prosperity. His legacy can still be seen in the modern-day city of Mawtaman, which was founded during his reign. Saw O's transformation of Martaban had significant regional implications, as it led to the growth of the Mon Kingdom and the development of the Ayutthaya Kingdom in present-day Thailand. Saw O's reign was also marked by the construction of the Martaban Palace, which was built to symbolize the kingdom's newfound independence. Saw O's diplomatic efforts also led to the establishment of trade relations with neighboring kingdoms, which helped to boost Martaban's economy. Saw O's reign was cut short by his death in 1323, but his legacy continues to be felt in the region. His transformation of Martaban had a lasting impact on the region, and he remains one of the most important figures in the history of the region.
